description_text:
This kit is intended for adding passenger railways to city scenes composed of Kit 01 (Kit 01 can be downloaded at https://www.cgtrader.com/free-3d-models/exterior/cityscape/building-blocks-for-modern-city-scenes-kit01 for free). There are two file formats in this kit: FBX and OBJ. Each format includes six files: three files containing building-block modules, and three files containing examples composed of the modules from this kit and Kit 01. More details are as the following.
(1) Modules in this kit: The file Kit02_Modules01 contains modules of roads, railway tracks, and vehicles (figure 02). Kit02_Modules02 contains a railway station module (figure 03). And Kit02_Modules03 contains other building modules (figure 04). The modules are made using SketchUp 8 and then exported to Blender 2.83 for file format conversion and rendering. The converted files still have the original SketchUp material settings, and the rendered appearances of the modules are shown in figures 02~04. Relevant materials are assigned names describing how they should look or what they should look like, such as red_smooth, yellow_rough, concrete, asphalt, ..., etc. The orientation setting is Y forward and Z up.
(2) Assembly Instructions: Regular steps of assembly include copying and pasting, rotating, and moving the modules. The modules are color-coded. A color-coded surface may be attached to a surface with the same color or a white surface (figure 05). The material names of the color-coded surfaces are color_code_00, color_code_01, ..., etc. Each file containing modules also contains a color code palette (figure 06). If modules from two different files are to be assembled, it is better to make sure in advance that the two palettes have the same color settings.
(3) Examples: The three examples are composed of modules from this kit and Kit 01. The file Kit02_Example01 shows an example of road and railway networks (figure 07). The road network is similar to those in Kit 01 examples. And the railway tracks are either elevated or lowered to avoid interferences with the ground traffic. Kit02_Example02 shows road and railway networks and a railway station (figure 10). The design of the railway station assumes that railways roughly form a rectangular network, and each major railway station locates at an intersection of two perpendicular railways. Adding buildings, trees, and vehicles to Kit02_Example02 results in Kit02_Example03 (figure 11). Using additional material settings, the rendered results of this example are shown in figures 12~25, but the additional material settings are not included in this kit. The tris number of Kit02_Example03 is 894,871. In the rendered figures, the red trains are long-distance trains, and the blue trains are commuter trains.
(4) Versions: This is the first version of this kit and was published on 2021/08/31.

description_text:
This is a big Historical building of Istanbul Technical University.
This model can be used on your Urban Design projects or any Architectural projects to add some datails to surroundings.
DIMENTIONSH: 25,5mW: 130,8mD: 65,3m
Originally created with SketchUp 2021, rendered V-Ray 5 and saved as also SketchUp 2016.
Model is included in 5 file formats. (SKP, FBX, OBJ, MAX, BLEND)
Blender file created with SketchUp importer add-on in Blender and used Decimate Modifier  to get clean topology.
First five renders from Blender Cycles other six renders from SketchUp Vray.
OBJ file Created from Blender 3.0MAX files created with OBJ (Exported from Blender)FBX exported from 3D's Max 2019.
FBX and OBJ tested on Twinmotion.
Model has no textures, Glass material and color maps.(Doors, Window Frames and Building Maps) BLENDER and SKETCHUP only.FBX, OBJ and MAX Files are as a single objetc file. (Blender did not made proper file with layers so i made a single object then exported.
Hope you enjoy using it.

description_text:
Public transport shelters - Shelter01 (70cm), Shelter02 (120cm), Dynamic Passenger Information

  - 2x versions of public transport shelters: smaller for thinner platform and bigger for wider platform

  - DPI module model based on the world-real device, installed on the pole with street button for text-to-speech funcion

  - elements paired for comfortable editing

  - bevel/chamfer editable in .blend format (modifiers collapsed in other formats) 

Formats

  - .blend - Blender 3.1, Cycles

  - .max - 3ds Max 2018, Vray 5/Corona 5

  - .fbx/.obj/.stl

  - maps: 4K maps, PBR

Details

  - Public Transport Shelter_01 (70cm) - beveled, PBR, 4K JPG, overlapping texturing based, maps: color, roughness, normal

  - Public Transport Shelter_02 (120cm) - beveled, PBR, 4K JPG, overlapping texturing based, maps: color, roughness, normal

  - Dynamic Passenger Information_module - beveled, PBR, 4K JPG, editable PSD file for placing your own text on the screen, maps: color, roughness, normal, emission

  - Street Button - beveled, PBR, 4K JPG, unwrapped, texture painted, maps: color, roughness, normal, decal mask

  - Shelter Bench0101, Shelter Bench0102 - beveled, PBR, 4K JPG, overlapping texturing based, maps: color, roughness, normal

Office File 3D model
Office File low-poly 3d model ready for Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), games and other real-time apps.

Home Office Desk - is a most generic home office desk setup. 

  - This Asset Pack contains in total 21 meshes: 

  - Desk

  - Computer

  - Monitor

  - Pair of Speakers

  - Photo Frame

  - Desk Lamp 

  - Router

  - Keyboard

  - Candle

  - Coffee Cup

  - Mouse

  - Phone Charger

  - Mouse Mat

  - 2 Journals

  - 5 Books

  - Models are Game-Ready/VR ready.

  - Models are low poly, created using 3DsMax 2016 application.

  - Models are polygonal (quads and tris).

  - For easy use objects are named logically (using English language).

  - Models are UV mapped and unwrapped (non-overlapping), contains Standard materials only.

  - Assets are fully textured in Substance painter (PBR), 2048x2048 .png's. Pack contains textures for Vray setup,for Unity 5 Standard Specular setup and for Unreal 4 engine as well as raw UV maps for all assets.

  - No special plugin is needed to open scene.

  - Models open with no problems in Blender, Unity 5 and Unreal 4.

description_text:
This Mithraeum Votive Altar is a low-poly model, based on the one discovered in the mithraeum under Saint  Clemente's Basilica. Mithraeums (Mithraea) are grotto or cave temples that house the services of practitioners of the Mithraic Mysteries cult. Mithras, while distinctly Roman in representation killing the bull (the Tauroctony) and being 'rock-born' is often depicted wearing the Phrygian Cap and the name seems to suggest possible connections with the Persian god named Mithra or the Vedic god named Mitra-Varuna. While the Mithraic Mysteries cult is no longer a mystery, the associated artifacts and artitecture found all over the world make for an interesting 3D project theme.
The model is UV mapped. Texture, displacement and normal maps are output to 4096 X 4096 pixels.

description_text:
This 3D model was originally created with Sketchup 6 and then converted to all other 3D formats. Native format is .skp 3dsmax scene is 3ds Max 2016 version, rendered with Vray 3.00 In 1596 a bigger army of the Turks attacked Eger, and took the castle after a short siege. Eger then fell under Turkish rule for more than eighty years and became the capital of a Turkish vilayet (administrative division). The Turks transformed churches into mosques, rebuilt the castle, and built other structures including public baths and minarets.
After the Turks' failed attempt to conquer Vienna, the Habsburgs, who controlled the rest of Hungary, began to drive the Turks out of the country. The Christian army led by Charles of Lorraine occupied the castle of Buda in 1686 and starved the castle of Eger into surrender in 1687.
Eger began to prosper again. The bishops reclaimed the town, causing many of the Protestant inhabitants to leave. During the 1703-1711 war of independence against the Habsburgs, the town supported the Hungarian leader Prince Francis II Rákóczi, but the Imperial army defeated the Hungarians, and soon after that Eger suffered from a plague. During the 1700s many people immigrated to Eger, and between 1725 and 1750 the population has risen from 6000 to 10,000. New buildings were built in Baroque (and later in Zopf) style, including the cathedral, the Episcopal Palace, the county hall, the college (now called Eszterházy College after its founder) and several churches. Also the mosques were transformed into Catholic churches.

The Galata Tower (Galata Kulesi in Turkish) — called Christea Turris (the Tower of Christ in Latin) by the Genoese — is a medieval stone tower in the Galata/Karaköy quarter of Istanbul, Turkey, just to the north of the Golden Horn's junction with the Bosphorus. One of the city's most striking landmarks, it is a high, cone-capped cylinder that dominates the skyline and offers a panoramic vista of Istanbul's historic peninsula and its environs.The nine-story tower is 66.90 meters tall (62.59 m without the ornament on top, 51.65 m at the observation deck), and was the city's tallest structure when it was built. The elevation at ground level is 35 meters above sea-level. The tower has an external diameter of 16.45 meters at the base, an 8.95 meters diameter inside, and walls that are 3.75 meters thick.The Romanesque style tower was built as Christea Turris (Tower of Christ) in 1348 during an expansion of the Genoese colony in Constantinople.

Ahura Mazda (also known as Ohrmazd, Ahuramazda, Hourmazd, Hormazd, and Hurmuz, Lord or simply as spirit) is the Avestan name for the creator and sole God of Zoroastrianism, the old Iranian religion predating Islam. Ahura Mazda is described as the highest spirit of worship in Zoroastrianism, along with being the first and most frequently invoked spirit in the Yasna. The literal meaning of the word Ahura is light and Mazda is wisdom. Zoroastrianism revolves around three basic tenets Good Thoughts, Good Words and Good Deeds.
-Wikipedia
